verdict.rationale: The GitHub README directly offers to "Run and chat with" a model. Community hands-on use of the `ollama run` CLI command (with --verbose) corroborates that model sessions run from the terminal. Missing for 10: the exact interactive CLI command is not quoted in first-party docs, and in-session features (multi-turn history, slash commands, exit and controls) are undocumented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal
